pageContent.title: Fast and easy support:
pageContent.content: Our form assistants are here to help you with your concerns. They are available at fixed locations during regular hours, and you do not need an appointment. This allows for convenient and straightforward access to our services. We specialize in processing complete applications with all the required documents so that the authorities can handle them quickly. Our goal is to make your requests as simple and efficient as possible.

pageContent.title: Who do the form assistants support?
content: The form assistants help all residents of Bremerhaven who need support in applying for social benefits.
If needed, language mediators are available to assist with communication.
